messages.subject: Leaflet  - Changing attributionControl position
parts:
Hi. I've developed a Shiny app that renders a Leaflet map.

I'm currently trying to change the attributionControl position. Here's what I did so far:

leaflet(options = list(attributionControl = F))

which removes the attributionControl completely. However, I'm just interested in changing its position (e.g., to "bottomleft"), but I couldn't find any options in the documentation.

Of course there's the official Leaflet JS documentation, which describes the option position under the Control.Attribution, but I can't seem to include this option into the R implementation.

Lastly, I've reached the following solution in JS from the Leaflet Google Group:

map = new L.Map('map', {
attributionControl: false
});
L.control.attribution({position: 'topright'}).addTo(map);

Seems like the red code block is the way to go, but I can't seem to translate it into R code. I've also tried to use the addControl function in R, but it just takes as an input HTML code.
